query.commandtext: INSERT INTO TQP_GDS_ET_VALUE (SRC_FILE_SEQ, DUT_NO, ET_ITEM_SEQ, MEAS_VALUE, VALUE_STATUS) VALUES (:src_file_seq, :dut_no, :et_item_seq, TO_BINARY_DOUBLE(:meas_value), :value_status)

query.description: 파일의 측정값 전체 (Die / 항목 순, 원문 헤더 포함)
query.commandtext: SELECT V.DUT_NO, V.ET_ITEM_SEQ, I.ITEM_NAME, V.MEAS_VALUE, V.VALUE_STATUS, V.JUDGE_FLAG, I.HEADER_TEXT, I.PARA_NAME, I.COND_VALUE, I.CHAIN_NAME, I.CHAIN_NAME2, I.UNIT, I.TEST_NO, I.DISPLAY_ORDER FROM TQP_GDS_ET_VALUE V JOIN TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM I ON I.ET_ITEM_SEQ = V.ET_ITEM_SEQ WHERE V.SRC_FILE_SEQ = :src_file_seq ORDER BY V.DUT_NO, I.DISPLAY_ORDER, V.ET_ITEM_SEQ

query.description: 저장 확정 검사: 측정값 수 / 미측정 수 / 빈 값 수
query.commandtext: SELECT COUNT(*) AS VALUE_COUNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN VALUE_STATUS = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS NOT_TESTED_COUNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN VALUE_STATUS = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS EMPTY_COUNT FROM TQP_GDS_ET_VALUE WHERE SRC_FILE_SEQ = :src_file_seq

query.description: 값 판정 (Upload 재설계 9.2절): Spec 없음 / Enable N / 빈 칸 = NULL, '-' = F, 범위 밖 = F (경계값 Pass), 나머지 P
query.commandtext: UPDATE TQP_GDS_ET_VALUE V SET JUDGE_FLAG = (SELECT CASE WHEN L.ENABLE_FLAG IS NULL OR L.ENABLE_FLAG <> 'Y' THEN NULL WHEN V.VALUE_STATUS = 'N' THEN 'F' WHEN V.VALUE_STATUS <> 'V' THEN NULL WHEN (L.LOWER_LIMIT IS NOT NULL AND V.MEAS_VALUE < L.LOWER_LIMIT) OR (L.UPPER_LIMIT IS NOT NULL AND V.MEAS_VALUE > L.UPPER_LIMIT) THEN 'F' ELSE 'P' END FROM TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM I LEFT JOIN TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT L ON L.FACTORY = I.FACTORY AND L.DEVICE_ID = I.DEVICE_ID AND L.TEST_PROGRAM = I.TEST_PROGRAM AND L.ITEM_NAME = I.ITEM_NAME WHERE I.ET_ITEM_SEQ = V.ET_ITEM_SEQ) WHERE V.SRC_FILE_SEQ = :src_file_seq

query.description: 파일에 값을 넣을 수 있는 측정 항목 번호 = 파일 Device + 공정의 등록 Parameter(사용 Y)
query.commandtext: SELECT I.ET_ITEM_SEQ FROM TQP_GDS_SRC_FILE F JOIN TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM I ON I.FACTORY = F.FACTORY AND I.DEVICE_ID = F.DEVICE_ID AND I.TEST_PROGRAM = F.TEST_PROGRAM AND I.USE_FLAG = 'Y' WHERE F.SRC_FILE_SEQ = :src_file_seq

query.description: 연관 분석: (Die, GDS Chain 이름) 별 Parameter / Fail / Pass 수 + 첫 Fail 항목 / 값
query.commandtext: SELECT D.DUT_NO, D.MAP_X, D.MAP_Y, D.JUDGE_FLAG AS DIE_JUDGE, UPPER(TRIM(I.GDS_CHAIN_NAME)) AS GDS_CHAIN_KEY, COUNT(*) AS PARA_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN V.JUDGE_FLAG = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FAIL_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN V.JUDGE_FLAG = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PASS_COUNT, MIN(CASE WHEN V.JUDGE_FLAG = 'F' THEN I.ITEM_NAME END) AS FIRST_FAIL_ITEM, MIN(CASE WHEN V.JUDGE_FLAG = 'F' THEN V.MEAS_VALUE END) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY CASE WHEN V.JUDGE_FLAG = 'F' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, I.ITEM_NAME) AS FIRST_FAIL_VALUE, MIN(CASE WHEN V.JUDGE_FLAG = 'F' THEN V.VALUE_STATUS END) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY CASE WHEN V.JUDGE_FLAG = 'F' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, I.ITEM_NAME) AS FIRST_FAIL_STATUS FROM TQP_GDS_ET_DIE D JOIN TQP_GDS_ET_VALUE V ON V.SRC_FILE_SEQ = D.SRC_FILE_SEQ AND V.DUT_NO = D.DUT_NO JOIN TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM I ON I.ET_ITEM_SEQ = V.ET_ITEM_SEQ WHERE D.SRC_FILE_SEQ = :src_file_seq AND I.GDS_CHAIN_NAME IS NOT NULL AND NVL(I.USE_FLAG, 'Y') <> 'N' GROUP BY D.DUT_NO, D.MAP_X, D.MAP_Y, D.JUDGE_FLAG, UPPER(TRIM(I.GDS_CHAIN_NAME)) ORDER BY D.DUT_NO, GDS_CHAIN_KEY

query.description: 연관 분석 Die 상세: Die 1개의 GDS Chain 연결 Parameter 값 + Spec + 판정
query.commandtext: SELECT V.DUT_NO, I.ITEM_NAME, I.HEADER_TEXT, I.CHAIN_NAME, I.CHAIN_NAME2, I.GDS_CHAIN_NAME, UPPER(TRIM(I.GDS_CHAIN_NAME)) AS GDS_CHAIN_KEY, V.MEAS_VALUE, V.VALUE_STATUS, L.LOWER_LIMIT, L.UPPER_LIMIT, V.JUDGE_FLAG, I.UNIT FROM TQP_GDS_ET_VALUE V JOIN TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM I ON I.ET_ITEM_SEQ = V.ET_ITEM_SEQ LEFT JOIN TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT L ON L.FACTORY = I.FACTORY AND L.DEVICE_ID = I.DEVICE_ID AND L.TEST_PROGRAM = I.TEST_PROGRAM AND L.ITEM_NAME = I.ITEM_NAME WHERE V.SRC_FILE_SEQ = :src_file_seq AND V.DUT_NO = :dut_no AND I.GDS_CHAIN_NAME IS NOT NULL AND NVL(I.USE_FLAG, 'Y') <> 'N' ORDER BY I.DISPLAY_ORDER, I.ITEM_NAME
